creator: Alexander Terp
description: Raised 2026-10-07 with pane names. muster completions writes a static clap_complete script, so --pane and --to complete nothing. Offering live names needs clap_complete's dynamic completer, which changes how muster completions works for every shell (the script calls back into muster). The word list was built with unique three-letter prefixes partly so this would be pleasant.
title: Shell completion offers live pane names
